scope: Candidate-only Conexiuni revision. No KG, pack, rejection inventory, ranking, runtime, verification artifact, or import output is changed.

policy.selection: No quota. Keep or rebuild only boards with exact predicates, one defensible partition, broad recognition, and a plausible play arc.
policy.new_graph_content: Forbidden: every surviving tile resolves to an existing node in the bound integration KG; nodes and edges remain empty.
policy.freshness: Every survivor is compared with the complete clean pack, durable rejection tombstones, and every other survivor.
policy.verification: The frozen factual and quality reviews are rejection evidence, not reusable import authorization after candidate-byte changes.
